review_candidates.title: B2B Sales Specialist
review_candidates.description: Company Description XAINIX LTD is a growing business-to-business solutions provider headquartered in New Cairo, serving clients across diverse industries. The company focuses on delivering innovative, value-driven services that help organizations optimize operations and achieve measurable results. XAINIX LTD emphasizes collaborative partnerships, tailoring its offerings to specific client needs and market conditions. Team members are encouraged to contribute ideas, take ownership, and support continuous improvement across the organization. Joining XAINIX LTD offers the opportunity to work in a dynamic environment with a strong focus on professional growth and customer success. Role Description The B2B Sales Specialist is responsible for identifying, developing, and closing business opportunities with corporate clients while maintaining long-term relationships. This contract role involves a hybrid work arrangement, with primary duties based in New Cairo and flexibility for partial work from home. Day-to-day tasks include prospecting new clients, conducting needs assessments, preparing tailored proposals and presentations, and managing the sales pipeline from initial contact to contract negotiation and completion. The B2B Sales Specialist will collaborate with internal teams to align solutions with client requirements, track market trends, and provide regular reports and forecasts. The role also includes follow-up with existing customers, ensuring satisfaction, uncovering upsell opportunities, and supporting the company’s overall revenue growth strategy. Qualifications Demonstrated ability in B2B sales, including prospecting, lead qualification, and pipeline management. Strong skills in relationship building, client communication, and negotiation with corporate stakeholders. Experience preparing and delivering professional sales presentations and proposals tailored to client needs. Solid understanding of commercial terms, contract structures, and basic financial concepts relevant to B2B deals. Proficiency with CRM tools and standard office software for tracking activities, reporting, and documentation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional language skills are an advantage. Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and adapt to a hybrid work environment in New Cairo. Prior experience in technology, services, or related B2B industries is preferred. Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Management, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. Commitment to ethical sales practices, customer-centric thinking, and continuous learning.

review_candidates.location: Al Ḩamul, Kafr ash Shaykh, Egypt
review_candidates.description: TSC is seeking a forward-thinking & highly motivated Material Planner Scheduler III to oversee the material planning process, ensuring the availability of materials for production while optimizing inventory levels and driving strategic improvements. The ideal candidate will act as a key liaison between Procurement, Production, and Program Management Teams, providing leadership and expertise to support the successful execution of TSC’s contracts. This is a hybrid position supporting TSC’s Huntsville AL location reporting to the Purchasing Manager. Responsibilities: Develop and manage advanced material requirements plans (MRP) to support complex production schedules and contract deliverables. Analyze long-term demand forecasts, production schedules, and inventory trends to ensure material availability and cost efficiency. Assist in leading cross-functional teams to address material planning challenges and implement solutions. Serve as the primary point of contact for material planning issues, providing guidance to junior planners and procurement teams. Collaborate with Procurement to ensure timely placement of purchase orders and delivery of materials. Develop strategies to optimize inventory levels, reduce excess and obsolete inventory, and minimize waste. Work closely with Production and Program Management teams to address material shortages and ensure uninterrupted operations. Adjust material plans to accommodate changes in production schedules, contract requirements, or unforeseen challenges. Identify and implement process improvements to enhance material planning efficiency and accuracy. Leverage data analytics, MRP system capabilities, and industry best practices to drive innovation in material planning processes. Manage daily activities of direct reports. Required Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field. Minimum 5-7 years of experience in material planning, supply chain management, or production planning, in the defense or aerospace industry or combination of degree and years of experiment. Extensive experience with MRP/ERP systems (e.g. Deltek CostPoint, SAP, Oracle, etc.) Advanced understanding of material planning processes, inventory management principles, and supply chain optimization. Familiarity with defense industry supply chain challenges and best practices. Strong leadership and decision-making abilities. Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities. Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills to collaborate with senior leadership and cross-functional teams. Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines. US Citizenship TSC Benefits: TSC offers a stable work environment, a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefits package; including ESOP participation, 401k Plan, Flexible Work Schedules, Tuition Reimbursement, Co-Sponsored Health Plan, Paid Leave and much more. Applying to TSC: Only those candidates invited for an interview will be contacted. Employment at TSC is contingent upon the successful completion of a comprehensive background check, security investigation, and a drug screening. Headquartered in Arlington, Virginia, TSC is an employee-owned company that has been providing high-quality technical services and solutions for over 50 years. Our diverse portfolio includes providing; Airborne Sensors and Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR); Electronic Warfare Systems; Air and Missile Defense; Space Systems, and Intelligence and Information Systems. TSC offers a professional working environment, a competitive salary, and an excellent benefits package.
